column3: With respect to the Northshore Mall Mortgage Loan (1.3%), the third largest tenant at the Mortgaged Property, Shaw's Supermarket (approximately 5.2% of the net rentable area), operates its space under a ground lease and insures the related building. Upon a casualty event to such building, such tenant may keep the insurance proceeds and elect whether to restore such building or terminate its lease and demolish and clear such building.
